policy.description: WorkCaptain charges EMPLOYERS only. Freelancers receive 100% of agreed contract value. This policy is structural — not a discount or promotion.

competitor_comparison._comment: What changes, when — competitor fee volatility positioning

upwork.name: Upwork
upwork.freelancer_fee_note: 10–20% sliding scale on earnings. Drops only after $10k with same client.
upwork.fee_volatility: HIGH — changed 3× in 5 years, most recently May 2023

fiverr.name: Fiverr
fiverr.freelancer_fee_note: 20% flat on all orders, no exceptions.
fiverr.fee_volatility: MEDIUM — stable 20% but introduced additional processing fees 2024

malt.name: Malt
malt.freelancer_fee_note: 0–5% depending on region and contract type.

workcaptain.name: WorkCaptain
workcaptain.freelancer_fee_note: 0% always. Structural policy, not a promotion.
workcaptain.fee_volatility: ZERO — policy is hardcoded, not configurable

payment_methods.label: Bank Transfer (Local / SARIE)
payment_methods.notes: Saudi SARIE real-time gross settlement network. Available: SAR and AED accounts.
payment_methods.notes_ar: شبكة ساريه السعودية للتسوية الفورية. متاح لحسابات: ريال سعودي ودرهم إماراتي.

payment_methods.label: SADAD
payment_methods.notes: Saudi bill payment network. Instant settlement within SADAD network.
payment_methods.notes_ar: شبكة مدفوعات سداد السعودية. تسوية فورية داخل شبكة سداد.

payment_methods.label: STC Pay
payment_methods.psp_fee_label_ar: رسوم اس تي سي باي (يدفعها صاحب العمل)
payment_methods.notes: STC Pay digital wallet. Instant transfer to STC Pay wallet.
payment_methods.notes_ar: محفظة STC Pay الرقمية. تحويل فوري إلى محفظة STC Pay.

payment_methods.label: International Wire (SWIFT)
payment_methods.notes: SWIFT international wire. Additional correspondent bank fees may apply.
payment_methods.notes_ar: تحويل دولي عبر سويفت. قد تطبق رسوم إضافية من البنوك الوسيطة.

payment_methods.label: Credit / Debit Card (Visa / Mastercard)
payment_methods.notes: Card-funded payments. Settlement to your registered bank account.
payment_methods.notes_ar: مدفوعات بالبطاقة. التسوية إلى حسابك البنكي المسجل.
